contracts.property: Returns the entry counter and increments it with saturation at u64::MAX.
Two reservations are strictly ordered and advance the counter by two when both increments fit.
Success exactly before u32::MAX; increments once on success, preserves the counter on failure, preserves pending_bytes on either outcome.
From MAX-1, the last success followed by failure leaves the sequence at MAX and preserves pending_bytes.
Derived initialization establishes the pending_bytes bound using exact primitive default models.

readability: requires/ensures with old(expr), mutable receiver/parameter state, pure if/else, Result is_ok/is_err, and Vec lengths. Omitted mutable fields are not implicitly preserved. Result payloads and Vec contents remain unmodeled.

models.str_to_string: Default-false Display capability enables panic-free string conversion for audited str specialization only. No blanket claim for user Display implementations. Allocation aborts remain possible.
models.primitive_defaults: Exact zero for all signed/unsigned integer widths, false for bool; no guarantee for arbitrary Default impls.
models.extern_spec_fix: PhantomData generic fields allow ?Sized parameters before the wrapper's final external Self field.
models.trust: External models are assumptions audited against pinned Rust 8925ea358a0f; positive/negative UI and native tests can falsify model claims but are not a formal proof of Rust internals.

validation.native_limitations: Broader suites are not green. Logs include missing /bin/bash, missing executable/sandbox setup errors and other environment-sensitive process failures. No sandbox code or environment variables were changed. The seven isolated unit failures are shell snapshot cases using /bin/bash.
